title: The Ashen Cup (Tournament Arena)
premise: You are Corvin Hale, a contracted fighter in the Ashen Cup, a winner-takes-all tournament held in the Cinder Arena. Tonight you fight Gravus Thorne, the reigning champion, in the third bout. The winner takes 500 crowns and is released from the Cup's contract. Bouts are called by bell, and a fighter who is not at the Ring Gate when their bout is called forfeits.
openingScene: The Fighters' Hold smells of lamp oil, liniment and old sweat. Through the iron grille at the far end the crowd roars for the first bout; a bell has just rung once. Marshal Dessa Orrin stands by the tally board with a slate, and across the room Gravus Thorne is tightening a strap without looking at you.

locations.name: The Fighters' Hold
locations.description: A long stone waiting room under the stands. Benches line the walls, a tally board hangs by the door, and a barred grille at the far end looks out on the tunnel to the ring. Fighters stretch, pray, or stare at nothing.
locations.ambient: The crowd's roar thuds through the ceiling and dust sifts down with every stamp.

improvisable.name: Bench Leg
improvisable.description: A splintered oak leg wrenched off a bench. Heavy, clumsy, better than bare hands.

locations.name: The Armoury Cage
locations.description: A caged alcove off the Hold where the Cup issues plain house weapons. Racks of dulled steel and hardened leather, watched by a bored quartermaster. Each fighter may draw one weapon before the gate.

locations.name: The Medic's Alcove
locations.description: A curtained corner with a cot, a basin of vinegar water and a shelf of bandages and bitter tinctures. Dr Pell patches fighters between bouts.

locations.name: The Ring Gate Tunnel
locations.description: A sloping stone tunnel ending in a portcullis, with a strip of white sand and sky beyond. Fighters wait here until the marshal raises the gate. The crowd's noise is deafening this close.
locations.ambient: Hot air and roaring pour down the tunnel.

locations.name: The Sand
locations.description: The open floor of the Cinder Arena: pale packed sand ringed by a high stone wall and tiered stands. The east half is churned and soft from flooding. Weapons from earlier rounds lie where they fell.
locations.ambient: A wall of noise, hot sun on sand, the smell of dust and blood.

locations.name: The Weapon Pit
locations.description: A sunken ring of sand at the arena's north edge where spent weapons are tossed between rounds. Spears, nets and maces lie in a tangle, some cracked, some rusted, a few still sound.

locations.name: The Broken Colonnade
locations.description: Toppled stone columns and splintered timber on the arena's west side, left as cover. Broken shafts and pike staves poke from the rubble, and a dented shield leans against a fallen drum.
locations.ambient: Grit trickles from the rubble when the crowd stamps.

improvisable.name: Broken Shaft
improvisable.description: A snapped pike shaft with a splintered end, usable as a club or a crude staff.

locations.name: The Barrier Wall
locations.description: The tall stone wall at the foot of the stands, hung with torn banners and iron rings. The crowd leans over the rail above, close enough to spit. A banner pole has worked loose from its bracket.
locations.ambient: Cheers and jeers rain down from above.

improvisable.name: Banner Pole
improvisable.description: A long ash pole pulled free of its bracket, with a rag of banner still knotted at one end.

items.name: House Gladius
items.description: A plain, serviceable short sword with a dulled edge, stamped with the Cup's mark.

items.name: House Spear
items.description: A six-foot ash spear with a leaf-shaped head, balanced for reach.

items.name: Iron Buckler
items.description: A small round iron shield with a worn grip.

items.name: Hardened Leather Jerkin
items.description: A boiled-leather vest, stiff and sweat-darkened.

items.name: Cracked Spear
items.description: A spear with a hairline split up the shaft. It will take a few hard blows and no more.

items.name: Rusted Mace
items.description: A flanged mace pitted with rust, still heavy enough to dent a helm.

items.name: Weighted Net
items.description: A lead-weighted net, sound and unfrayed. Good for tangling an opponent's feet.

items.name: Snapped Sword
items.description: A sword snapped a hand's breadth above the guard. The stub is an ugly, short stabbing weapon.

items.name: Dented Shield
items.description: A round wooden shield, caved in at the rim, with the boss still solid.

items.name: Dropped Trident
items.description: A trident dropped by a fighter from an earlier bout, one tine slightly bent.

events.name: Corvin Hale versus Gravus Thorne: bout three called at the Ring Gate

npcs.name: Dessa Orrin
npcs.description: A lean woman with a slate and a brass handbell, who runs the Cup's bouts to the minute and has no patience for stragglers.
npcs.dialogueStyle: Clipped and procedural; answers rules questions exactly and nothing else.

npcs.name: Gravus Thorne
npcs.description: A broad, scarred champion in a plate cuirass, unhurried and unreadable, who has won the Cup three years running.
npcs.dialogueStyle: Quiet and sparing; speaks as if every word costs coin.
secrets: He is afraid of losing his place as champion.

npcs.name: Marek Ironhand
npcs.description: A grey, one-eyed veteran who has fought in the Cup for twelve years and now mostly gives advice nobody asked for.
npcs.dialogueStyle: Gruff and rambling, fond of war stories, blunt about danger.
motivations: See one more good fighter win
secrets: Marek has watched Gravus's last three Cups closely.
refuses: Naming the wager he placed on your bout.

npcs.name: Sela Quickwater
npcs.description: A wiry, nervous young net-fighter who talks fast when she is frightened, and she is frightened.
npcs.dialogueStyle: Fast, tumbling sentences; trails off when she says too much.
secrets: Sela saw Gravus's shield strap fray in his last bout.

npcs.name: Bruno Stonejaw
npcs.description: A hulking, bruised brawler sitting alone with his fists wrapped, glaring at anyone who looks his way for long.
npcs.dialogueStyle: Short, hostile growls; respects only strength.
secrets: Gravus beat Bruno last year and Bruno has never forgiven it.

npcs.name: Dr Pell
npcs.description: A tired, ink-stained physician who stitches fighters between bouts and charges whatever they can pay.

npcs.name: Hob the Quartermaster
npcs.description: A heavy-set, bored man behind the cage who checks every fighter's tally token before releasing a weapon.
npcs.dialogueStyle: Flat and bureaucratic; says the same line twice.
motivations: Be done by the final bout

facts.statement: The Ashen Cup winner takes 500 crowns and is released from the Cup's contract.
facts.subject: Ashen Cup

facts.statement: Corvin Hale fights Gravus Thorne in the third bout of the evening.
facts.subject: Corvin Hale

facts.statement: Bouts in the Ashen Cup end by yielding or incapacitation, and a killing blow forfeits the prize money.
facts.subject: Ashen Cup
facts.object: yield or incapacitation; killing forfeits prize

facts.statement: Two bouts are fought before yours, and the marshal rings a bell when each is called.
facts.subject: Ashen Cup
facts.object: bell, two bouts before bout three

facts.statement: A fighter who is not at the Ring Gate when their bout is called forfeits it.
facts.subject: Ring Gate

facts.statement: Each fighter may draw one weapon from the Armoury Cage before the gate, and anything lying on the sand is fair to take once the bout begins.
facts.subject: Armoury Cage
facts.object: one weapon per fighter; sand weapons fair game

facts.statement: The east half of the Sand is soft from flooding and slows anyone in heavy armour.
facts.subject: The Sand

facts.statement: The Weapon Pit holds tossed spears, nets and maces, and some of them are cracked or rusted and will not last.
facts.subject: Weapon Pit
facts.object: spears, nets, maces; some cracked or rusted

facts.statement: Broken shafts in the colonnade rubble make serviceable improvised clubs.
facts.subject: Broken Colonnade

facts.statement: Gravus Thorne opens every bout with a heavy overhead strike and is slow to recover from it.
facts.subject: Gravus Thorne

facts.statement: Gravus Thorne's kite shield strap is badly frayed and may give way under a hard blow.
facts.subject: Gravus Thorne

facts.statement: Dr Pell will treat wounds between bouts for a coin or a favour.
facts.subject: Dr Pell
facts.object: for a coin or a favour

facts.statement: Bruno Stonejaw lost to Gravus Thorne in last year's Cup and has never forgiven it.
facts.subject: Bruno Stonejaw
